evals.prompt: make my vault at ~/vault truly queryable - I want to search it and see what links where
evals.expected_output: Skill fires. Ingest runs first via scripts/obsidian_kg.py, then queries answer from the resulting .obsidian-kg.db; no inline reimplementation of parsing.
expectations: scripts/obsidian_kg.py ingest is executed via Bash before any query
Search uses the engine's query subcommand (bm25/FTS5), not raw grep over the vault
The agent reads the underlying .md files before asserting facts from snippets
No pip install, network call, or API key is involved

evals.prompt: what links to my 'Weekly Review' note? include embeds
evals.expected_output: Backlinks query via the engine, resolving the note by basename; results distinguish edge kind (link vs embed) and syntax (wiki vs md).
expectations: The backlinks subcommand is executed with the vault path and note name
If the db is missing, ingest is run first rather than hand-parsing the vault
Results reported with edge kind so embeds are distinguishable from links

evals.prompt: ingest this vault of concept notes - it's our OKF knowledge base, standard markdown links, frontmattered concepts
evals.expected_output: Skill does NOT fire. OKF vaults belong to okf-kg (strict md-link edges). Correct behavior: invoke okf-kg instead.
expectations: The obsidian-kg skill is not invoked
The okf-kg skill handles the request
No .obsidian-kg.db is created in the OKF vault

evals.prompt: clean up the formatting and callouts in this note in my vault
evals.expected_output: Skill does NOT fire. Authoring/formatting belongs to the obsidian skill; obsidian-kg only indexes and queries.
expectations: The obsidian-kg skill is not invoked
The obsidian (authoring) skill handles the request
No ingest or query subcommand is executed

evals.prompt: search says my vault has ambiguous links - two notes both called 'Index'. what happened and what do I do?
evals.expected_output: Skill fires. stats subcommand surfaces the ambiguous-link examples; explanation matches engine behavior (bare [[link]] matching multiple basenames is recorded, never guessed) and the fix is a path-qualified link.
expectations: The stats subcommand is executed and its ambiguous-link output cited
The explanation states the engine records ambiguity rather than guessing a target
The proposed fix is a path-qualified wikilink like [[folder/Index]]
No edge is fabricated for the ambiguous link
